import { computed, inject, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { AutocompleteViewport, useForwardProps, type AutocompleteViewportProps } from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { autocompleteItemsKey } from "./context"

const props = defineProps<AutocompleteViewportProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>()

defineSlots<{
  /** With `items` on Autocomplete, called once per item (`v-slot="{ item }"`); otherwise plain content. */
  default?: (props: { item: string; index: number }) => unknown
}>()

const items = inject(autocompleteItemsKey, undefined)

const delegated = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})
const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegated)
</script>

<template>
  <AutocompleteViewport
    data-slot="autocomplete-list"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('min-h-0 flex-1 scroll-fade overflow-y-auto', props.class)"
  >
    <template v-if="items">
      <template v-for="(item, index) in items" :key="item">
        <slot :item="item" :index="index" />
      </template>
    </template>
    <slot v-else :item="''" :index="-1" />
  </AutocompleteViewport>
</template>

import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { X } from "@lucide/vue"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { useBanner } from "./context"

const props = defineProps<{ class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>()
// Your @click runs first; call event.preventDefault() in it to keep the banner open.
const emit = defineEmits<{ click: [event: MouseEvent] }>()

  emit("click", event)
  if (!event.defaultPrevented) dismiss()

        'shrink-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground',
        barClassName,
        props.class,

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner"
import { buttonVariants, type ButtonVariantProps } from "."

interface Props extends PrimitiveProps {
  variant?: ButtonVariantProps["variant"]
  size?: ButtonVariantProps["size"]
  class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
  disabled?: boolean
  /** Shows a Spinner, sets aria-busy, and blocks clicks while keeping focus. */
  loading?: boolean
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  as: "button",
  variant: "default",
  size: "default",
})

const iconOnly = computed(() => typeof props.size === "string" && props.size.startsWith("icon"))

// A loading button stays focusable (no disabled attribute) but swallows clicks.
function blockWhileLoading(event: MouseEvent) {
  if (props.loading) {
    event.preventDefault()
    event.stopImmediatePropagation()
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    data-slot="button"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :disabled="disabled || undefined"
    :data-loading="loading ? '' : undefined"

<script setup lang="ts" generic="Datum extends Record<string, unknown>">
import { h, render } from "vue"
import VisCrosshair from "@unovis/vue/components/crosshair"
import VisTooltip from "@unovis/vue/components/tooltip"

import ChartTooltipContent from "./ChartTooltipContent.vue"
import { chartColor, useChart, type ChartTooltipPayload } from "./context"

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const props = defineProps<{
  /** Field of the datum shown as the tooltip heading, like the category on the x axis. */
  labelKey?: keyof Datum & string
  /** Turns the datum into the heading. Wins over labelKey. */
  labelFormatter?: (datum: Datum) => string
  /** Series to list. Defaults to every key of the Chart config. */
  keys?: (keyof Datum & string)[]
}>()

const { config } = useChart()

function payloadOf(datum: Datum): ChartTooltipPayload[] {
  const keys = props.keys ?? Object.keys(config.value)
  return keys
    .filter((key) => datum[key] !== undefined)
    .map((key) => ({ dataKey: key, name: key, value: datum[key], color: chartColor(key) }))
}

// Unovis takes the tooltip as HTML: render the Vue content off-screen and hand over its markup.
function template(datum: Datum) {
  if (!datum) return ""
  const label = props.labelFormatter
    ? props.labelFormatter(datum)
    : props.labelKey
      ? String(datum[props.labelKey] ?? "")
      : undefined
  const el = document.createElement("div")
  render(h(ChartTooltipContent, { active: true, payload: payloadOf(datum), label, config: config.value }), el)
  const html = el.innerHTML
  render(null, el)
  return html
}

function circleColor(_datum: Datum, i: number) {
  const keys = props.keys ?? Object.keys(config.value)
  return chartColor(keys[i % Math.max(1, keys.length)] ?? "")
}
</script>

<template>
  <!-- Unovis puts its tooltip above the plot (z-index 999999); the box is see-through so ChartTooltipContent draws the card. -->
  <VisTooltip />
  <VisCrosshair :template="template" :color="circleColor" v-bind="$attrs" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, nextTick, onMounted, provide, reactive, ref, watch, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { ListboxRoot, useForwardProps, type ListboxRootProps } from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { commandContextKey, defaultCommandFilter, type CommandFilter, type CommandItemEntry } from "./context"

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<
    Omit<ListboxRootProps, "modelValue" | "defaultValue" | "multiple" | "selectionBehavior"> & {
      /** The highlighted item's value, like cmdk's `value`. Can be bound with `v-model`. */
      modelValue?: string
      /** Scores each item against the search. Return 0 to hide it. */
      filter?: CommandFilter
      /** Set to false to filter items yourself (async search). */
      shouldFilter?: boolean
      class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
    }
  >(),
  { highlightOnHover: true, shouldFilter: true, modelValue: undefined, filter: undefined },
)
const emit = defineEmits<{ "update:modelValue": [value: string] }>()

const delegated = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, modelValue: _modelValue, filter: _filter, shouldFilter: _shouldFilter, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})
const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegated)

const listbox = ref<InstanceType<typeof ListboxRoot> | null>(null)
const search = ref("")
const items = reactive(new Map<string, CommandItemEntry>())

const scores = computed(() => {
  const map = new Map<string, number>()
  const filter = props.filter ?? defaultCommandFilter
  for (const [id, entry] of items) {
    map.set(id, !props.shouldFilter || !search.value ? 1 : filter(entry.value, search.value, entry.keywords))
  }
  return map
})

const isItemVisible = (id: string) => {
  const entry = items.get(id)
  return !!entry && (entry.forceMount || (scores.value.get(id) ?? 0) > 0)
}

const visibleCount = computed(() => [...items.keys()].filter(isItemVisible).length)

provide(commandContextKey, {
  search,
  shouldFilter: computed(() => props.shouldFilter),
  register: (id, entry) => items.set(id, entry),
  unregister: (id) => items.delete(id),
  isItemVisible,
  isGroupVisible: (groupId) => [...items].some(([id, entry]) => entry.groupId === groupId && isItemVisible(id)),
  visibleCount,
})

// cmdk keeps the first match highlighted while typing and on open.
watch(search, () => listbox.value?.highlightFirstItem())
onMounted(() =>
  nextTick(() => {
    if (props.modelValue !== undefined) listbox.value?.highlightItem(props.modelValue)
    else listbox.value?.highlightFirstItem()
  }),
)
watch(
  () => props.modelValue,
  (value) => {
    if (value !== undefined) listbox.value?.highlightItem(value)
  },
)

function onHighlight(payload: { value: unknown } | undefined) {
  if (payload && typeof payload.value === "string" && payload.value !== props.modelValue) {
    emit("update:modelValue", payload.value)
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <ListboxRoot
    ref="listbox"
    data-slot="command"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('flex h-full w-full flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-popover text-popover-foreground', props.class)"
    @highlight="onHighlight"
  >
    <slot />
  </ListboxRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, useId, watch, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { ListboxItem, type PrimitiveProps } from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { commandContextKey, commandGroupKey } from "./context"

const props = defineProps<
  PrimitiveProps & {
    /** Matched against the search and emitted on select. Defaults to the item's text. */
    value?: string
    /** Extra words the search also matches. */
    keywords?: string[]
    disabled?: boolean
    /** Keep the item rendered even when it does not match. */
    forceMount?: boolean
    class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
  }
>()
const emit = defineEmits<{ select: [value: string] }>()

const context = inject(commandContextKey)!
const groupId = inject(commandGroupKey, undefined)
const id = useId()

const element = ref<InstanceType<typeof ListboxItem> | null>(null)
const textValue = ref("")
const resolvedValue = computed(() => (props.value ?? textValue.value).trim() || id)

function register() {
  context.register(id, {
    value: resolvedValue.value,
    keywords: props.keywords ?? [],
    groupId,
    forceMount: !!props.forceMount,
  })
}

register()
onMounted(() => {
  const el = (element.value?.$el ?? null) as HTMLElement | null
  if (props.value === undefined && el) textValue.value = el.textContent ?? ""
})
watch([resolvedValue, () => props.keywords, () => props.forceMount], register, { deep: true })
onBeforeUnmount(() => context.unregister(id))

const visible = computed(() => context.isItemVisible(id))

const itemClassName =
  "relative flex min-h-7 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-2 py-1.5 text-xs outline-hidden select-none data-highlighted:bg-accent data-highlighted:text-accent-foreground data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-50 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"

function onSelect(event: CustomEvent) {
  // Command items run an action; they don't stay checked like a listbox option.
  event.preventDefault()
  emit("select", resolvedValue.value)
}
</script>

<template>
  <ListboxItem
    v-if="visible"
    ref="element"
    data-slot="command-item"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :value="resolvedValue"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :class="cn(itemClassName, props.class)"
    @select="onSelect"
  >
    <slot />
  </ListboxItem>
</template>

  { mode: "single", modelValue: undefined, defaultValue: undefined },
)

const emit = defineEmits<{
  "update:modelValue": [value: DateValue | DateRange | undefined]
}>()

const open = ref(false)
const internal = shallowRef<DateValue | DateRange | undefined>(props.defaultValue)
const current = computed(() => (props.modelValue !== undefined ? props.modelValue : internal.value))

function isRange(value: unknown): value is DateRange {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && "start" in value
}

function toText(date: DateValue) {
  return format(date.toDate(getLocalTimeZone()), dateFormat)
}

const range = computed(() => (isRange(current.value) ? current.value : undefined))
const single = computed(() => (current.value && !isRange(current.value) ? current.value : undefined))
const empty = computed(() => (props.mode === "range" ? !range.value?.start : !single.value))

const label = computed(() => {
  if (props.mode === "range") {
    const value = range.value
    if (!value?.start) return props.placeholder ?? "Pick a range"
    if (!value.end || isSameDay(value.start, value.end)) return toText(value.start)
    return `${toText(value.start)} – ${toText(value.end)}`
  }
  return single.value ? toText(single.value) : (props.placeholder ?? "Pick a date")
})

function onSelect(next: unknown) {
  const value = (next ?? undefined) as DateValue | DateRange | undefined
  internal.value = value
  emit("update:modelValue", value)
  if (props.mode === "range") {
    if (isRange(value) && value.start && value.end && !isSameDay(value.start, value.end)) open.value = false
  } else {
    open.value = false
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Popover v-model:open="open">
    <PopoverTrigger as-child :disabled="disabled">
      <Button
        :id="id"
        variant="outline"
        :disabled="disabled"
        :class="cn('min-w-52 justify-start font-normal', empty && 'text-muted-foreground', props.class)"
      >
        <CalendarIcon data-icon="inline-start" />
        {{ label }}
      </Button>
    </PopoverTrigger>
    <PopoverContent align="start" class="w-auto p-3">
      <Calendar
        v-if="mode === 'range'"
        initial-focus
        mode="range"
        :model-value="range"
        :default-placeholder="range?.start"
        @update:model-value="onSelect"
      />
      <Calendar
        v-else
        initial-focus
        mode="single"
        :model-value="single"
        :default-placeholder="single"
        @update:model-value="onSelect"
      />
    </PopoverContent>
  </Popover>
</template>

    return { emoji: text.slice(0, space), name, keywords, tone }
  }),
}))

/** Adds the skin tone after the first code point, before any variation selector. */
export function withTone(emoji: Emoji, tone: number) {
  if (!emoji.tone || !tone) return emoji.emoji
  const [first, ...rest] = [...emoji.emoji]
  return `${first}${tones[tone]}${rest.join("").replace(/^\uFE0F/, "")}`
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, getCurrentInstance, ref, watch, type ComponentPublicInstance, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { FormRoot, type FormRootProps } from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import type { FormErrors, FormSlotProps, FormValues } from "./types"

/**
 * A form on Reka UI's FormRoot: native validation is turned off in favour of
 * field messages, the first invalid control takes focus on submit, server
 * `errors` show until their field is edited, and `formSubmit` hands over the
 * values of every named control.
 *
 * Reka fields (FieldRoot) register with it directly. The Lumen Field and plain
 * inputs are checked through their native constraints (`required`, `type`,
 * `pattern`…), and the default slot receives `{ invalid, errors }` to wire them.
 */
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<FormRootProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]; errors?: FormErrors }>(),
  { validationMode: "onSubmit", as: "form" },
)
const emits = defineEmits<{
  /** The native submit event, once every field is valid. */
  submit: [event: SubmitEvent]
  /** The values of every named control. Listening to it prevents the native submission. */
  formSubmit: [values: FormValues, event: SubmitEvent]
  /** A field with a server error was edited: the errors that remain. */
  clearErrors: [errors: FormErrors]
}>()

const delegated = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, errors: _errors, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})

const instance = getCurrentInstance()
const rootRef = ref<ComponentPublicInstance<{}, { validate: (name?: string) => boolean }> | null>(null)
const formElement = () => (rootRef.value?.$el as HTMLFormElement | undefined) ?? null

const submitCount = ref(0)
const nativeErrors = ref<Record<string, string>>({})
const cleared = ref(new Set<string>())
watch(
  () => props.errors,
  () => {
    cleared.value = new Set()
  },
)

type Control = HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement | HTMLTextAreaElement

function controls(name?: string): Control[] {
  const form = formElement()
  if (!form) return []
  return (Array.from(form.elements) as Control[]).filter(
    (el) => "willValidate" in el && el.name && (!name || el.name === name),
  )
}

function validateControl(el: Control) {
  const next = { ...nativeErrors.value }
  if (el.willValidate && !el.validity.valid) next[el.name] = el.validationMessage
  else delete next[el.name]
  nativeErrors.value = next
  return el.validity.valid
}

/** Validates every control, or those named `name`. Returns whether they're all valid. */
function validate(name?: string) {
  const nativeValid = controls(name)
    .map(validateControl)
    .every(Boolean)
  const rekaValid = rootRef.value?.validate(name) ?? true
  return nativeValid && rekaValid
}
defineExpose({ validate })

const serverErrors = computed(() => {
  const out: Record<string, string[]> = {}
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(props.errors ?? {})) {
    if (cleared.value.has(name)) continue
    const messages = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value]
    if (messages.length) out[name] = messages
  }
  return out
})

const slotProps = computed<FormSlotProps>(() => {
  const errors: Record<string, string[]> = {}
  for (const [name, message] of Object.entries(nativeErrors.value)) errors[name] = [message]
  for (const [name, messages] of Object.entries(serverErrors.value)) {
    errors[name] = [...(errors[name] ?? []), ...messages]
  }
  const invalid: Record<string, boolean> = {}
  for (const name of Object.keys(errors)) invalid[name] = true
  return { invalid, errors, submitCount: submitCount.value }
})

function collectValues(form: HTMLFormElement): FormValues {
  const values: FormValues = {}
  for (const [name, value] of new FormData(form).entries()) {
    const previous = values[name]
    if (previous === undefined) values[name] = value
    else values[name] = Array.isArray(previous) ? [...previous, value] : [previous, value]
  }
  return values
}

// Runs before FormRoot's own handler: a native control that fails its
// constraints stops the submission there.
function onSubmitCapture(event: Event) {
  submitCount.value++
  const invalidControls = controls().filter((el) => !validateControl(el))
  if (invalidControls.length === 0) return
  event.preventDefault()
  event.stopImmediatePropagation()
  const first = invalidControls[0]!
  first.focus()
  if (first instanceof HTMLInputElement) first.select?.()
}

function revalidate(event: Event, trigger: "change" | "blur") {
  const el = event.target as Control | null
  if (!el || !("willValidate" in el) || !el.name) return
  const mode = props.validationMode
  if (
    (trigger === "change" && (mode === "onChange" || (mode === "onSubmit" && submitCount.value > 0))) ||
    (trigger === "blur" && mode === "onBlur")
  ) {
    validateControl(el)
  }
}

function onEdit(event: Event) {
  const name = (event.target as Control | null)?.name
  if (name && props.errors && name in props.errors && !cleared.value.has(name)) {
    cleared.value = new Set([...cleared.value, name])
    const { [name]: _removed, ...rest } = props.errors
    emits("clearErrors", rest)
  }
  revalidate(event, "change")
}

const hasFormSubmitListener = computed(() => Boolean(instance?.vnode.props?.onFormSubmit))
const rootListeners = computed(() => ({
  onSubmit: (event: SubmitEvent) => emits("submit", event),
  ...(hasFormSubmitListener.value

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Fragment, Text, computed, h, inject, isVNode, type Component, type HTMLAttributes, type VNode } from "vue"
import { ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUp, Command } from "@lucide/vue"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { kbdSizeKey, kbdVariants, type KbdVariantProps } from "."

const props = defineProps<{
  size?: KbdVariantProps["size"]
  variant?: KbdVariantProps["variant"]
  class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
}>()

const slots = defineSlots<{ default?: () => VNode[] }>()

const groupSize = inject(kbdSizeKey, undefined)
const resolvedSize = computed(() => props.size ?? groupSize?.value)

const KEY_ICONS: Record<string, Component> = {
  "⌘": Command,
  "↑": ArrowUp,
  "↓": ArrowDown,
  "←": ArrowLeft,
  "→": ArrowRight,
}

const KEY_GLYPH_RE = /(⌘|↑|↓|←|→)/

// JetBrains Mono lacks these glyphs: swap each for a Lucide icon, keeping the
// character for screen readers.
function renderText(text: string): (VNode | string)[] {
  const parts = text.split(KEY_GLYPH_RE)
  if (parts.length === 1) return [text]
  return parts.flatMap((part): (VNode | string)[] => {
    const Icon = KEY_ICONS[part]
    if (!Icon) return part ? [part] : []
    return [h("span", { class: "sr-only" }, part), h(Icon, { "aria-hidden": "true", class: "size-[1em]" })]
  })
}

function transform(nodes: unknown[]): (VNode | string)[] {
  return nodes.flatMap((node) => {
    if (typeof node === "string") return renderText(node)
    if (!isVNode(node)) return []
    if (node.type === Text && typeof node.children === "string") return renderText(node.children)
    if (node.type === Fragment && Array.isArray(node.children)) return transform(node.children)
    return [node]
  })
}

const Content = () => transform(slots.default?.() ?? [])
</script>

<template>
  <kbd
    data-slot="kbd"
    :class="cn(kbdVariants({ size: resolvedSize, variant }), props.class)"
  >
    <Content />
  </kbd>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, provide, ref, watch, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { PinInputRoot, type PrimitiveProps } from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { OTPFieldKey, filterOTPValue, type OTPValidationType } from "./context"

interface Props extends PrimitiveProps {
  /** Number of cells. The value is clamped to it and is complete at this length. */
  length: number
  /** The code as one string. Can be bound with `v-model`. */
  modelValue?: string
  defaultValue?: string
  /** Characters allowed in a cell. */
  validationType?: OTPValidationType
  /** Runs after filtering; its result is filtered again and clamped to `length`. */
  normalizeValue?: (value: string) => string
  /** Hides the characters like a password field. */
  mask?: boolean
  /** Sets `autocomplete="one-time-code"` so phones offer the code from a message. */
  otp?: boolean
  /** Submits the owning form once the code is complete. */
  autoSubmit?: boolean
  placeholder?: string
  disabled?: boolean
  required?: boolean
  name?: string
  /** Id of the first input; the next ones get `{id}-2`, `{id}-3`… */
  id?: string
  dir?: "ltr" | "rtl"
  class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  validationType: "numeric",
  otp: true,
  placeholder: "",
  modelValue: undefined,
})

const emit = defineEmits<{
  "update:modelValue": [value: string]
  /** Fires when the code reaches `length`. */
  complete: [value: string]
  /** Fires with the attempted text when characters were rejected. */
  invalid: [value: string]
}>()

function normalize(raw: string) {
  let value = filterOTPValue(raw, props.validationType)
  if (props.normalizeValue) value = filterOTPValue(props.normalizeValue(value), props.validationType)
  return value.slice(0, props.length)
}

const local = ref(normalize(props.modelValue ?? props.defaultValue ?? ""))
watch(
  () => props.modelValue,
  (value) => {
    if (value !== undefined) local.value = normalize(value)
  },
)

const cells = computed(() => local.value.split(""))

const rootEl = ref<{ $el?: HTMLElement } | null>(null)

function onUpdate(value: (string | number | undefined)[]) {
  const raw = value.map((cell) => (cell == null ? "" : String(cell))).join("")
  const next = normalize(raw)
  if (next.length < raw.replace(/\s/g, "").slice(0, props.length).length) emit("invalid", raw)
  if (next === local.value) return
  local.value = next
  emit("update:modelValue", next)
  if (next.length === props.length) {
    emit("complete", next)
    if (props.autoSubmit) rootEl.value?.$el?.closest("form")?.requestSubmit()
  }
}

let counter = 0
provide(OTPFieldKey, {
  id: computed(() => props.id),
  validationType: computed(() => props.validationType),
  nextIndex: () => counter++,
})
</script>

<template>
  <PinInputRoot
    ref="rootEl"
    data-slot="otp-field"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :model-value="cells"
    :type="validationType === 'numeric' ? 'number' : 'text'"
    :mask="mask"
    :otp="otp"
    :placeholder="placeholder"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :required="required"
    :name="name"
    :dir="dir"
    :data-complete="local.length === length ? '' : undefined"
    :class="cn('flex items-center gap-2', props.class)"
    @update:model-value="onUpdate"
  >
    <slot :model-value="local" />
  </PinInputRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, inject, onMounted, ref, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { PinInputInput, type PrimitiveProps } from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { OTPFieldKey, filterOTPValue } from "./context"

const props = defineProps<
  PrimitiveProps & {
    /** Position of the cell. Optional: inputs number themselves in order. */
    index?: number
    disabled?: boolean
    class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
  }
>()

const context = inject(OTPFieldKey, null)
const autoIndex = ref(context ? context.nextIndex() : 0)
const inputRef = ref<{ $el?: HTMLElement } | null>(null)

// Setup order can drift when inputs mount later: the DOM order is the truth.
onMounted(() => {
  const el = inputRef.value?.$el
  const root = el?.closest('[data-slot="otp-field"]')
  if (!el || !root) return
  const position = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('[data-slot="otp-field-input"]')).indexOf(el)
  if (position !== -1) autoIndex.value = position
})

const index = computed(() => props.index ?? autoIndex.value)

const id = computed(() => {
  const base = context?.id.value
  if (!base) return undefined
  return index.value === 0 ? base : `${base}-${index.value + 1}`
})

// Base UI rejects letters in numeric mode and digits in alpha mode before they land.
function onBeforeInput(event: Event) {
  const data = (event as InputEvent).data
  if (!context || !data) return
  if (filterOTPValue(data, context.validationType.value).length === 0) event.preventDefault()
}
</script>

<template>
  <PinInputInput
    ref="inputRef"
    data-slot="otp-field-input"
    :index="index"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :id="id"
    :class="
      cn(
        'size-9 rounded-xl border border-border bg-transparent text-center text-xs outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/30 disabled:opacity-50',
        props.class,
      )

    @beforeinput="onBeforeInput"

export type PhoneCountry = {
  /** ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, upper case: "FR". */
  code: string
  /** Calling code without the plus: "33". */
  dial: string
  /** National format, one # per digit: "# ## ## ## ##". Groups of three by default. */
  pattern?: string
  /** Drop a leading 0 typed in the national number, as most of Europe writes it. */
  trunkZero?: boolean
}

/** A starting list. Pass your own `countries` for more, fewer, or other formats. */
export const phoneCountries: PhoneCountry[] = [
  { code: "FR", dial: "33", pattern: "# ## ## ## ##", trunkZero: true },
  { code: "BE", dial: "32", pattern: "### ## ## ##", trunkZero: true },

  { code: "CA", dial: "1", pattern: "(###) ###-####" },

  { code: "BR", dial: "55", pattern: "## #####-####" },
  { code: "AR", dial: "54" },
  { code: "MA", dial: "212", pattern: "# ## ## ## ##", trunkZero: true },
  { code: "DZ", dial: "213", trunkZero: true },
  { code: "TN", dial: "216", pattern: "## ### ###" },
  { code: "SN", dial: "221", pattern: "## ### ## ##" },
  { code: "CI", dial: "225" },
  { code: "NG", dial: "234", trunkZero: true },
  { code: "ZA", dial: "27", trunkZero: true },
  { code: "EG", dial: "20", trunkZero: true },
  { code: "TR", dial: "90", trunkZero: true },
  { code: "IL", dial: "972", trunkZero: true },
  { code: "AE", dial: "971", trunkZero: true },
  { code: "SA", dial: "966", trunkZero: true },
  { code: "IN", dial: "91", pattern: "##### #####" },
  { code: "CN", dial: "86" },
  { code: "JP", dial: "81", trunkZero: true },
  { code: "KR", dial: "82", trunkZero: true },
  { code: "SG", dial: "65", pattern: "#### ####" },
  { code: "AU", dial: "61", pattern: "### ### ###", trunkZero: true },
  { code: "NZ", dial: "64", trunkZero: true },
]

/** "FR" → 🇫🇷, from the regional indicator letters. */
export function flag(code: string) {
  return String.fromCodePoint(...[...code.toUpperCase()].map((c) => 0x1f1a5 + c.charCodeAt(0)))
}

export function formatPhoneNumber(digits: string, pattern?: string) {
  if (!digits) return ""
  if (!pattern) return digits.replace(/(\d{3})(?=\d)/g, "$1 ")
  let out = ""
  let i = 0
  for (const char of pattern) {
    if (i >= digits.length) break
    if (char === "#") out += digits[i++]
    else out += char
  }
  // Digits past the pattern are kept, not dropped.
  return i < digits.length ? `${out}${digits.slice(i)}` : out
}

/** "+33612345678" → the country and national digits, preferring `preferred` on shared codes. */
export function parsePhoneNumber(value: string, countries: PhoneCountry[], preferred: string) {
  const digits = value.replace(/\D/g, "")
  if (!value.startsWith("+") || !digits) return null
  const matches = countries
    .filter((country) => digits.startsWith(country.dial))
    .sort((a, b) => b.dial.length - a.dial.length)
  if (!matches.length) return null
  const longest = matches.filter((c) => c.dial.length === matches[0].dial.length)
  const country = longest.find((c) => c.code === preferred) ?? longest[0]
  return { country, national: digits.slice(country.dial.length) }
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, provide, ref, toRef, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { promptInputKey, type PromptStatus } from "./context"

/**
 * The composer: a growing textarea over a toolbar. Enter sends and
 * Shift+Enter breaks a line, or ⌘/Ctrl+Enter sends with `submit-on="mod-enter"`.
 */
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    /** v-model. Leave it unbound to let the field keep its own text. */
    modelValue?: string
    defaultValue?: string
    status?: PromptStatus
    submitOn?: "enter" | "mod-enter"
    disabled?: boolean
    /** Listening to `@stop` turns the send button into a stop button while busy. */
    onStop?: () => void
    class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
  }>(),
  { modelValue: undefined, defaultValue: "", status: "ready", submitOn: "enter", disabled: undefined, onStop: undefined }
)

const emit = defineEmits<{
  "update:modelValue": [value: string]
  /** Called with the trimmed text. The field clears itself after. */
  submit: [value: string]
}>()

const uncontrolled = ref(props.defaultValue)
const value = computed(() => props.modelValue ?? uncontrolled.value)

function setValue(next: string) {
  if (props.modelValue === undefined) uncontrolled.value = next
  emit("update:modelValue", next)
}

function submit() {
  const text = value.value.trim()
  if (!text || props.disabled || props.status === "submitted" || props.status === "streaming") return
  emit("submit", text)
  setValue("")
}

provide(promptInputKey, {
  value,
  setValue,
  submit,
  status: toRef(props, "status"),
  onStop: toRef(props, "onStop"),
  submitOn: toRef(props, "submitOn"),
  disabled: toRef(props, "disabled"),
})
</script>

<template>
  <form
    data-slot="prompt-input"
    :data-status="status"
    :class="

        'flex w-full flex-col gap-1 rounded-3xl border border-border bg-card p-2 transition-colors',
        'focus-within:border-ring focus-within:ring-3 focus-within:ring-ring/30',
        props.class,
      )
    "
    @submit.prevent="submit"
  >
    <slot />
  </form>
</template>

  if (event.defaultPrevented || event.key !== "Enter" || event.isComposing) return
  const mod = event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/**
 * "3 minutes ago" that keeps itself current. A native <time> with the exact
 * date in its title and datetime, so the precise moment is one hover away.
 */
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    date: Date | string | number
    locale?: string
    titleFormat?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions
    class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
  }>(),
  { titleFormat: () => ({ dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" }) }
)

const units: [Intl.RelativeTimeFormatUnit, number][] = [
  ["year", 365 * 24 * 3600],
  ["month", 30 * 24 * 3600],
  ["week", 7 * 24 * 3600],
  ["day", 24 * 3600],
  ["hour", 3600],
  ["minute", 60],
  ["second", 1],
]

function relative(date: Date, now: number, locale: string | undefined) {
  const seconds = Math.round((date.getTime() - now) / 1000)
  const format = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(locale, { numeric: "auto" })
  for (const [unit, size] of units) {
    if (Math.abs(seconds) >= size || unit === "second") {
      if (unit === "second" && Math.abs(seconds) < 45) return format.format(0, "second")
      return format.format(Math.round(seconds / size), unit)
    }
  }
  return ""
}

/** How often to re-render: every 15s in the first minute, then by the unit shown. */
function nextTick(date: Date, now: number) {
  const age = Math.abs(now - date.getTime()) / 1000
  if (age < 60) return 15_000
  if (age < 3600) return 60_000
  if (age < 86_400) return 3_600_000
  return null
}

const date = computed(() => new Date(props.date))
// Default to the page's language, not the browser's, so the text matches the UI around it.
const resolvedLocale = computed(
  () =>
    props.locale ?? (typeof document === "undefined" ? undefined : document.documentElement.lang || undefined)
)
const now = ref(Date.now())

let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
watch(
  [date, now],
  ([d, n]) => {
    clearTimeout(timer)
    const delay = nextTick(d, n)
    if (delay === null) return
    timer = setTimeout(() => (now.value = Date.now()), delay)
  },
  { immediate: true }
)
onBeforeUnmount(() => clearTimeout(timer))

const title = computed(() => new Intl.DateTimeFormat(resolvedLocale.value, props.titleFormat).format(date.value))
const text = computed(() => relative(date.value, now.value, resolvedLocale.value))
</script>

<template>
  <time
    data-slot="relative-time"
    :datetime="date.toISOString()"
    :title="title"
    :class="cn('tabular-nums', props.class)"
  >{{ text }}</time>
</template>

/**
 * A search field with a clear button. Escape clears a field that holds text;
 * on an empty field it passes through. Other attributes land on the input.
 */
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    /** v-model. Leave it unbound to let the field keep its own text. */
    modelValue?: string
    defaultValue?: string
    clearLabel?: string
    disabled?: boolean
    class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
  }>(),
  { modelValue: undefined, defaultValue: "", clearLabel: "Clear search", disabled: undefined },
)

const emit = defineEmits<{
  "update:modelValue": [value: string]
  /** Only when the field is emptied by the button or Escape. */
  clear: []
  keydown: [event: KeyboardEvent]
}>()

const inputRef = ref<{ $el: HTMLInputElement }>()
const uncontrolled = ref(props.defaultValue)
const current = computed(() => props.modelValue ?? uncontrolled.value)

function setValue(next: string) {
  if (props.modelValue === undefined) uncontrolled.value = next
  emit("update:modelValue", next)
}

function clear() {
  setValue("")
  emit("clear")
  inputRef.value?.$el.focus()

function onKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  emit("keydown", event)
  if (event.key === "Escape" && current.value !== "" && !event.defaultPrevented) {
    event.preventDefault()
    clear()
  }
}

const clearClassName = computed(() =>
  cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "ghost", size: "icon-xs" }), "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"),
)

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { Clock } from "@lucide/vue"

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from "@/components/ui/popover"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import TimePickerColumn from "./TimePickerColumn.vue"
import { formatTime, pad, parseTime, toValue, type Time, type TimeOption } from "./utils"

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    /** "HH:mm", 24-hour, like a native time input. Used when v-model is not bound. */
    defaultValue?: string
    /** Minutes between two options. */
    step?: number
    hourCycle?: 12 | 24
    placeholder?: string
    disabled?: boolean
    name?: string
    id?: string
    class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
    ariaLabel?: string
    labels?: { hours?: string; minutes?: string; period?: string }
  }>(),
  {
    step: 15,
    hourCycle: 24,
    placeholder: "Pick a time",
    labels: () => ({}),
  },
)

/** "HH:mm", 24-hour. */
const model = defineModel<string>()

const open = ref(false)
const uncontrolled = ref(props.defaultValue)
const time = computed(() => parseTime(model.value ?? uncontrolled.value))

function commit(next: Time, close: boolean) {
  const formatted = toValue(next)
  uncontrolled.value = formatted
  model.value = formatted
  if (close) open.value = false
}

const current = computed<Time>(() => time.value ?? { hours: 9, minutes: 0 })
const isPm = computed(() => current.value.hours >= 12)

const hourOptions = computed<TimeOption[]>(() =>
  props.hourCycle === 24
    ? Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, h) => ({ value: h, label: pad(h) }))
    : Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => {
        const display = i === 0 ? 12 : i
        return { value: isPm.value ? i + 12 : i, label: String(display) }
      }),
)

const minuteOptions = computed<TimeOption[]>(() =>
  Array.from({ length: Math.ceil(60 / Math.max(1, props.step)) }, (_, i) => ({
    value: i * props.step,
    label: pad(i * props.step),
  })).filter((option) => option.value < 60),
)

const periodOptions: TimeOption[] = [
  { value: 0, label: "AM" },
  { value: 1, label: "PM" },
]

const display = computed(() => (time.value ? formatTime(time.value, props.hourCycle) : props.placeholder))
// Keep the time in the name: a bare aria-label would hide the value.
const triggerLabel = computed(() => (props.ariaLabel ? `${props.ariaLabel}, ${display.value}` : undefined))
</script>

<template>
  <Popover v-model:open="open">
    <PopoverTrigger as-child>
      <Button
        :id="id"
        variant="outline"
        :disabled="disabled"
        :aria-label="triggerLabel"
        data-slot="time-picker"
        :class="cn('min-w-36 justify-start font-normal tabular-nums', !time && 'text-muted-foreground', props.class)"
      >
        <Clock data-icon="inline-start" />
        {{ display }}
      </Button>
    </PopoverTrigger>
    <input v-if="name" type="hidden" :name="name" :value="time ? toValue(time) : ''" />
    <PopoverContent align="start" class="flex w-auto gap-1 p-1" @open-auto-focus.prevent>
      <TimePickerColumn
        auto-focus
        :label="labels.hours ?? 'Hours'"
        :options="hourOptions"
        :selected="time ? current.hours : undefined"
        @select="(hours) => commit({ hours, minutes: current.minutes }, false)"
      />
      <div aria-hidden="true" class="w-px self-stretch bg-border" />
      <TimePickerColumn
        :label="labels.minutes ?? 'Minutes'"
        :options="minuteOptions"
        :selected="time ? current.minutes : undefined"
        @select="(minutes, close) => commit({ hours: current.hours, minutes }, close)"
      />
      <template v-if="hourCycle === 12">
        <div aria-hidden="true" class="w-px self-stretch bg-border" />
        <TimePickerColumn
          :label="labels.period ?? 'AM or PM'"
          :options="periodOptions"
          :selected="time ? (isPm ? 1 : 0) : undefined"
          @select="(period) => commit({ hours: (current.hours % 12) + (period ? 12 : 0), minutes: current.minutes }, false)"
        />
      </template>
    </PopoverContent>
  </Popover>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, type HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { useVModel } from "@vueuse/core"
import { ToggleGroupRoot, useForwardProps, type AcceptableValue, type ToggleGroupRootProps } from "reka-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<
    Omit<ToggleGroupRootProps, "type" | "modelValue" | "defaultValue"> & {
      /** Pressed values. Always an array, like the React version. */
      modelValue?: AcceptableValue[]
      defaultValue?: AcceptableValue[]
      /** Let several items be pressed at once. */
      multiple?: boolean
      class?: HTMLAttributes["class"]
    }
  >(),
  { multiple: false, loop: true, rovingFocus: true, orientation: "horizontal", modelValue: undefined, defaultValue: () => [] }
)
const emits = defineEmits<{ "update:modelValue": [value: AcceptableValue[]] }>()

const values = useVModel(props, "modelValue", emits, {
  passive: true,
  defaultValue: props.defaultValue,
}) as { value: AcceptableValue[] }

const delegated = computed(() => {
  const { class: _class, multiple: _multiple, modelValue: _modelValue, defaultValue: _defaultValue, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})
const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegated)

const rootValue = computed(() => (props.multiple ? values.value : values.value[0]))

function onUpdate(value: AcceptableValue | AcceptableValue[]) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) values.value = value
  else values.value = value === undefined || value === null || value === "" ? [] : [value]
}
</script>

<template>
  <ToggleGroupRoot
    data-slot="toggle-group"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :type="multiple ? 'multiple' : 'single'"
    :model-value="rootValue"
    :data-orientation="orientation"
    :class="cn('flex w-fit items-center justify-center gap-0.5 rounded-4xl bg-muted p-0.5', 'data-[orientation=vertical]:flex-col', props.class)"
    @update:model-value="onUpdate"
  >

  </ToggleGroupRoot>
</template>
